head.text: repne cmpsb byte ptr [rsi], byte ptr [rdi]
and dword ptr cs:[rbx + rbx*2 + 0x1e], ebp
rep movsb byte ptr [rdi], byte ptr [rsi]
cmpsd dword ptr cs:[rsi], dword ptr [rdi]
rep movsb byte ptr [rdi], byte ptr [rsi]

interpretation.coverage: Instruction coverage is a linear Capstone sweep of every executable section. Recognized skipdata bytes are classified individually as 64-bit #UD encodings, invalid prefixes/VEX/ModR/M, truncated instructions, or other rejected opcodes. Unknown fallback labels are excluded from semantic classified coverage.
interpretation.gaps: A skipdata byte is present in the file. It is not a missing region. Capstone refused to start a 64-bit instruction there; the next linear instruction begins immediately after the skipped run. The taxonomy names the reason.
interpretation.pdata: Exception-directory ranges are loader-consumed unwind facts. In this binary many are MBA epilogue fragments or obfuscated blocks, not conventional compiler functions.
interpretation.ghidra: The validated Ghidra catalog contributes 8105 internal entry candidates and is hash-pinned in authority metadata. Entries can overlap because Ghidra bodies, unwind ranges, and linkage stubs are distinct authority surfaces.
interpretation.calls: IAT call instructions are call sites, never function seeds. Each call receives at most one primary owner: the smallest exact Ghidra body first, otherwise the smallest containing .pdata range, otherwise unresolved.
interpretation.non_claim: A mapped instruction or named wrapper is static recovery, not runtime policy, bypass guidance, or a complete deobfuscation of MBA control flow.
